_meta.description: Ego item templates. Each entry describes modifiers applied to a base item when it rolls as "great" quality during generation. Fields: serial (MAngband ego index), name (suffix/prefix added to item name), rating (affects dungeon level "feeling" score), xtra (0=none, 1-3=random bonus pool), max_to_hit/dam/ac (max random bonus; not yet applied at runtime), pval (magnitude for stat/skill flags), depth/rarity/cost (generation parameters), applicable_types (tval+sval range filter), slots (derived equipment slots), item_categories (derived category), flags (MAngband flag strings).

xtra_pools.1: Random sustain: one of SUST_STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHR chosen at item generation

ACTIVATE.reference_note: Activation payload is item/serial-specific and defined in activation catalogs.

runtime_notes.note: inert_flags are stored but have no runtime effect in current IronHell implementation (src/game/systems/character/resistances.ts flagsToAffixes does not map them). IGNORE_* are item preservation flags and may intentionally remain inert in a PvE context. MIGHT/SHOTS are explicitly active combat affixes and are not inert.

sources.slay_kill_brand_flags: item flags from ego/artifact/base item definitions

combat_modifier_policy.immunity_interaction: BRAND_* applies multiplier only when target immunity flag for that element is absent.

normalization.notes: Flag semantics are now catalog-referenced. Runtime behavior is unchanged.
